== About ==
'''z4''' was a site created by '''[[electricdog]]''' (@e1ectricdog) on August 15, 2024. It originally offers three features: domain buying/hiring, an account system, and a Work In Progress music system. They also used to host site-jams with Robux rewards.

In early of 2025, z4 was widely regarded as a "glazed" website. z4 glazing has since quietened down.

You can view their official website at [https://www.electricdog.xyz/z4 www.electricdog.xyz/z4] (currently in redevelopment) and contact them at [mailto:catweb@electricdog.xyz catweb@electricdog.xyz].

== Design ==
When you first got to z4's homepage (z4.rbx/query), it would show 2 buttons, those being '''Domains''' and '''Funding'''. On the top right, there was a button where you can create a z4 account. Finally, on the bottom left, there was a search bar where you can search z4's database of domains that were currently being sold.
[[File:Z4-homepage-2025-december.png|none|thumb|360x360px|The homepage when logged into a z4 account with a Donor profile decoration, and playing music. December 2025]]
If you already had z4 account, the white button on the top right would not show. Instead, your account's profile picture would show in the footer, bottom right. Clicking on it would show account configuration links, as well has a dropdown to change themes inside the query page [BETA]. Additionally, next to the Funding button, there would be an additional '''Settings''' button, where you could change your theme, see domain purchases, etc. For representatives, there would have been a dashboard button present (as seen in photo)

== Features ==

=== Domains ===
[[File:Z4-domains-2025-december.png|none|thumb|500x500px]]
z4 sold rare domains, usually targeting domains that were short, had common words, or had popular, recognizable names. Once you picked a domain from the list of domains, it would show you z4's '''terms/instructions'''. When agreed to, you could choose between '''purchasing/hire purchasing''' the site. There would be four options (A, B, C and D), of which would have been discussed by the '''z4 representative''' you were communicating with (see paragraph below).

Purchasing domains from z4 required either '''[[electricdog]]''' (@e1ectricdog), '''or any other representative''' to be present within the server, as the process required the user to communicate with them through in-game chat. If you purchased through one of the four payment options without prior communication, '''your purchase would have been treated as a non-refundable donation'''.

=== Accounts ===
[[File:Z4-account-settings-2025-december.png|none|thumb|500x500px|A user's z4 account settings. Certain links have been redacted due to them being not related to the current article]]
z4 had a simple account API. Accounts had names, a profile picture, and a bio. The API also provided a simple method for retrieving a player's z4 account info. You can find more information about it on '''[https://www.roblox.com/games/start?placeId=16855862021&launchData=z4.infobyte.rbx/api-reference/account-api z4.infobyte.rbx/api-reference/account-api]'''.

== Pages ==
Here are the known pages for z4.rbx:

=== z4.rbx ===

* /query - Home page.

* /music - Find tracks that can be played on the home page.

* /introduction - An introduction to z4.

* /whats-new - Changelog page. You will automatically be sent here when a new update releases and you haven't seen this page since then.

=== account.z4.rbx ===

* / - Guides you through the process of account creation.

* /accessibility - Enable/disable certain z4 features like "Detailed hints in load screens", or "Always use detailed searching".

* /account - Account settings. You can manage your name, profile picture, bio, etc.

* /creation - The screen that comes after signup.

* /credits - Credits page.

* /my-purchases - A list of transactions you made with z4.

* /privacy - A screen with one button that deletes your data. (Your z4 account will be removed.)

* /settings - Theme manager. You can choose from 7 of z4's preset themes (matching CatWeb's), or use a custom theme.

* /themes/create - Custom theme creator.

=== domains.z4.rbx ===

* / - A list of domains currently being sold by z4. (outdated)

* /v2 - A list of domains currently being sold by z4 showing the prices for each individual domain.

* /purchase - Literally just a transition screen to the payment section.

* /buying - The legacy v3 version of the z4 payment system. Some prices are outdated and the Customer Support panel is non functional.

* /buying/hire - The legacy v2 version of the z4 payment system. No longer works.

=== payment.z4.rbx ===

* / - Walks you through the payment steps. Refer to the "Domains" section above. (outdated)

* /v2 - The newer payment page that streamlines the process further and discontinues Discount Codes and the option to hire domains

== Shutdown ==
Midway through 2026 electricdog had a major disagreement with the CatWeb team regarding moderation, specifically the user '''kol''' (@koliemini) who had been a moderator since CatWebs inception. Because of this electricdog was revoked of his Tester role and banned from the CatWeb Community Server. In response on the 29th June, 2026 electricdog shut down z4 indefinitely. z4 now redirects to '''harpingseals.rbx'''.
